verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers only individual identity verification (government ID, selfie, watchlist/PEP/adverse-media reports) and generic workflow/webhook infrastructure — there is no mention of business registry lookups, UBO identification, or a documented KYB-to-KYC chaining flow for business owners. Since business verification is a plausible offering for an identity-verification platform, absence of evidence means this axis is unmet rather than inapplicable.
